newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine gas company issues $60.5 million bond.
newsitem.headline: Argentine gas company issues $60.5 million bond.

text.p: Transportadora de Gas del Norte SA, Argentina's second largest gas transportation company, said Thursday it has sold $60.5 million convertible bonds as part of its $320 million global debt program.
The bond, with a 9.45 percent coupon, matures in 12 years and has a grace period of two years. The bond was totally subscribed by the International Financial Corporation, a World Bank agency.
This was the sixth issue of the gas transporter's debt program. The program was approved by the board of directors of the company and by Argentina's National Securities Commission earlier this year.
